description: LoomSeal v0.1 conformance vectors. Each entry declares whether the bundle must verify, and when it must not, which check fails and why. A verifier is conformant when it agrees with every entry.

vectors.name: anchor-corrupt-token
vectors.why: An rfc3161 proof that does not open as a timestamp token fails the anchor check: a carried proof that is garbage must never grade the same as no proof.

vectors.name: anchor-declared-head-proof
vectors.why: An rfc3161 proof on a declared head beyond the bundled claims is not opened and earns no anchored level, because the link it attests is tied to nothing the verifier confirmed.

vectors.name: anchor-matches-nothing
vectors.why: An anchor whose coordinates match nothing in the bundle fails.

vectors.name: anchor-only-declared-head
vectors.why: An anchor matching only a head beyond the claims is reported but not counted as anchored.

vectors.name: attestation-keyid-mismatch
vectors.why: A counterparty attestation whose key_id is not the digest of its public key is refused, so it cannot misname its signer.

vectors.name: attestation-role-swapped
vectors.why: A counterparty attestation whose role was changed after signing no longer verifies, because the counter-signature binds the role as well as the link.

vectors.name: attestation-with-time
vectors.why: An attestation whose at member is set carries the signing time inside the signed bytes; altering the time after the fact breaks the counter-signature.

vectors.name: attested-claim
vectors.why: A loomseal-chain-v1 claim carrying a counterparty attestation over its link verifies; the counter-signature is checked against the signer's own key and reported as vouched.

vectors.name: casefold-coords-seq
vectors.why: A case variant of a claim's chain seq is refused at parse rather than folded onto the seq coordinate.

vectors.name: casefold-head-attestation-key-id
vectors.why: A case variant of a head attestation's key_id is refused at parse rather than folded onto the key the attestation is checked against.

vectors.name: casefold-head-seq
vectors.why: A case variant of the chain head's seq is refused at parse rather than folded onto the coordinate the head match reads.

vectors.name: casefold-producer-install-id
vectors.why: A case variant of producer.install_id is refused at parse rather than folded onto the install_id field.

vectors.name: casefold-signature-key-id
vectors.why: A case variant of a signature's key_id is refused at parse rather than folded onto the key_id field.

vectors.name: casefold-span-beat
vectors.why: The span field beat is read from the exact canonical key, so a case variant holding a value that would pass does not fold onto it and the span check sees the lie.

vectors.name: casefold-span-cadence-s
vectors.why: The span field cadence_s is read from the exact canonical key, so a case variant holding a value that would pass does not fold onto it and the span check sees the lie.

vectors.name: casefold-span-cadence-s-chain-v1
vectors.why: Under a profile whose link commits the whole claim, the span field cadence_s is still read from its exact key, so a variant that folds onto it does not stand in for it.

vectors.name: casefold-span-count
vectors.why: The span field count is read from the exact canonical key, so a case variant holding a value that would pass does not fold onto it and the span check sees the lie.

vectors.name: casefold-span-stream
vectors.why: The span field stream is read from the exact canonical key, so a case variant holding a value that would pass does not fold onto it and the span check sees the lie.

vectors.name: casefold-switchtender-actor
vectors.why: The bound member actor is read from the exact canonical key, so a case variant holding the honest value does not fold onto it and the link recomputes over the lie.

vectors.name: casefold-switchtender-actor-type
vectors.why: The bound member actor_type is read from the exact canonical key, so a case variant holding the honest value does not fold onto it and the link recomputes over the lie.

vectors.name: casefold-switchtender-content-digest
vectors.why: The bound member content_digest is read from the exact canonical key, so a case variant holding the honest value does not fold onto it and the link recomputes over the lie.

vectors.name: casefold-switchtender-install-id
vectors.why: The bound member install_id is read from the exact canonical key, so a case variant holding the honest value does not fold onto it and the link recomputes over the lie.

vectors.name: casefold-switchtender-method
vectors.why: The bound member method is read from the exact canonical key, so a case variant holding the honest value does not fold onto it and the link recomputes over the lie.

vectors.name: casefold-switchtender-on-behalf-of
vectors.why: The bound member on_behalf_of is read from the exact canonical key, so a case variant holding the honest value does not fold onto it and the link recomputes over the lie.

vectors.name: casefold-switchtender-path
vectors.why: The bound member path is read from the exact canonical key, so a case variant holding the honest value does not fold onto it and the link recomputes over the lie.

vectors.name: chain-broken-prev
vectors.why: A prev link that does not match the prior link breaks continuity.

vectors.name: chain-v1-evidence-packaging
vectors.why: An evidence entry's present and location are packaging details outside the committed content, so a chain-v1 link recomputes whatever way this copy packages its evidence.

vectors.name: duplicate-top-level-key
vectors.why: A repeated object key has no canonical form and is rejected.

vectors.name: evidence-referenced
vectors.why: Evidence not supplied to the verifier is referenced, never counted as verified.

vectors.name: foreign-install-linear
vectors.why: A loomseal-chain-v1 chain whose params.install_id is not the producer's is refused, which is what stops one install from restating another's producer block over its links.

vectors.name: head-attestation-role-swapped
vectors.why: A head attestation whose role is rewritten after signing fails, because the role sits inside the signed preimage.

vectors.name: head-attested
vectors.why: A head-level attestation added after signing verifies over the chain head and is reported as vouching for it; the producer signature is untouched because the member is stripped from its preimage.

vectors.name: head-behind-claims
vectors.why: A head sequence behind the newest claim is a broken chain.

vectors.name: head-wrong-link
vectors.why: A head at the newest sequence must carry that claim's link.

vectors.name: keyed-anchored-structural
vectors.why: A keyed chain verifies structurally only, so an anchor over its head is matched and reported but earns no anchored wording: the verifier never recomputed the link to tie it to the claim content.

vectors.name: keyed-structural
vectors.why: A keyed chain verifies as structural: continuity holds, links are not recomputed.

vectors.name: lone-high-surrogate
vectors.why: A lone high surrogate escape is invalid and is rejected, not coerced.

vectors.name: lone-low-surrogate
vectors.why: A lone low surrogate escape is invalid and is rejected, not coerced.

vectors.name: merkle-anchor-on-consistency-root
vectors.level: signed, chained (tree of 6, append-only from 4), anchored by reference
vectors.why: An anchor on the root a verified consistency proof starts from matches, because the proof shows the log grew from exactly the root the anchor fixed.

vectors.name: merkle-bad-inclusion-path
vectors.why: An audit path with a substituted sibling does not fold to the root the head names.

vectors.name: merkle-claim-altered
vectors.why: A claim edited after the tree was built no longer hashes to its own leaf, so the leaf does not recompute.

vectors.name: merkle-claim-with-prev
vectors.why: A tree claim carrying a previous link implies a linear chain that is not being verified.

vectors.name: merkle-consistency
vectors.why: A consistency proof from an earlier root verifies, proving the log grew by appending only, which a hash chain cannot state on its own.

vectors.name: merkle-consistency-power-of-two
vectors.why: A consistency proof whose earlier size is a power of two verifies. That case seeds the old root rather than reading it from the proof, and an implementation that expects it in the proof rejects a valid bundle.

vectors.name: merkle-consistency-rewritten
vectors.why: A log that changed an entry it had already published cannot produce a consistency proof from the root the world saw before the change. Every disclosed leaf here still recomputes, so only the append-only check catches it.

vectors.name: merkle-evidence-packaging
vectors.why: An evidence entry's present and location are packaging details outside the committed content, so a merkle leaf recomputes whatever way this copy packages its evidence. Every other member of the entry, the digest included, is inside the leaf.

vectors.name: merkle-foreign-install
vectors.why: A tree whose leaves bind an install other than the producer's is refused, which is what stops one producer from re-signing another's log and anchor.

vectors.name: merkle-right-edge
vectors.why: A leaf on the right edge of a nine leaf log verifies, where the tree is least regular and a fold that mishandles the odd node fails.

vectors.name: merkle-seq-past-tree
vectors.why: A claim naming a position past the tree size is outside the log the head attests.

vectors.name: merkle-single-leaf
vectors.why: A log of one leaf verifies with an empty audit path, which is the correct and only path at that size.

vectors.name: merkle-sparse
vectors.why: A tree bundle disclosing two non-contiguous leaves of a six leaf log verifies, because each one folds through its audit path to the root the signed head names.

vectors.name: merkle-wrong-leaf-index
vectors.why: A claim moved to another position does not prove membership at that position.

vectors.name: non-integer-number
vectors.why: A fractional number is outside the integer profile and is rejected.

vectors.name: noncontiguous-seq
vectors.why: Claims must be contiguous in sequence; a gap is a broken chain.

vectors.name: number-exceeds-2p53
vectors.why: An integer beyond 2^53 does not round-trip through an IEEE double and is rejected.

vectors.name: producer-keyid-mismatch
vectors.why: The producer key_id must be the digest of the embedded public key.

vectors.name: raw-invalid-utf8
vectors.why: Invalid UTF-8 input is rejected, not coerced to the replacement character.

vectors.name: record-member-on-nonrecord
vectors.why: A reserved disclosed-records member on a non-record claim is an ordinary payload member the link does not commit, so a conforming bundle carrying one still verifies, with the member reported unchecked.

vectors.name: signature-alg-rewritten
vectors.why: alg is outside the signed bytes, so a verifier rejects a foreign value rather than dispatching on it.

vectors.name: signature-first-entry-verifies
vectors.why: A bundle whose first producer entry verifies and whose second does not is verified, since the entry behind the genuine one names the producer key and rides no foreign key.

vectors.name: signature-foreign-keyid
vectors.why: A signatures entry naming a key the producer block does not hold fails the bundle. The array sits outside the signed bytes, so a foreign entry is a rider nothing vouches for, and it must not travel inside a green verdict.

vectors.name: signature-no-entry-verifies
vectors.why: A bundle carrying two producer entries, neither of which verifies, fails at the signature step: more entries earn nothing unless one of them is genuine.

vectors.name: signature-second-entry-verifies
vectors.why: A bundle whose first producer entry does not verify and whose second does is verified: the rule is that at least one producer entry verifies, in any position.

vectors.name: signature-unknown-member
vectors.why: An unknown member inside a signature object fails at parse. Signature objects sit outside the signed bytes, so member strictness is the only thing keeping unsigned data out of them.

vectors.name: signed-chained-anchored
vectors.why: An anchor whose coordinates match the verified head earns the anchored level.

vectors.name: signed-chained-full
vectors.why: An unkeyed loomseal-chain-v1 chain with the head tied to the newest claim.

vectors.name: signed-only
vectors.why: A bundle with no chain reaches the signed level and no further.

vectors.name: span-false-count
vectors.why: A count that does not match the sequence numbers is a signed false statement and fails.

vectors.name: span-gap
vectors.level: signed, chained (full), anchored by reference, spanned
vectors.why: Beats further apart than the declared cadence are a reported gap, never a hidden one and never a failure.

vectors.name: span-mid-adoption
vectors.level: signed, chained (full), anchored by reference, spanned
vectors.why: A chain adopting the profile mid-life attests its entire prior population at beat 1.

vectors.name: span-missing-beat
vectors.why: A beat number that skips is a deleted window and fails.

vectors.name: span-valid
vectors.level: signed, chained (full), anchored by reference, spanned
vectors.why: Two beats whose counts recompute from the sequence numbers earn the spanned level.

vectors.name: subject-unknown-type
vectors.why: A subject type outside the known vocabulary is reported and never failed: subject types are informational, and a frozen verifier must not call a newer producer's subject a schema error.

vectors.name: swatch-attested
vectors.why: A claim that is both selectively disclosable and counter-signed verifies, since disclosures and attestations are independent members outside the link.

vectors.name: swatch-foreign-disclosure
vectors.why: A disclosure for a field absent from the committed _sd set matches no digest and fails, so a holder cannot invent a field the producer never committed.

vectors.name: swatch-forged-value
vectors.why: A disclosed field whose value was changed after signing no longer hashes to its committed digest, so selective disclosure fails while the signature and chain still verify.

vectors.name: swatch-fully-redacted
vectors.why: A claim that discloses none of its redactable fields still verifies; the _sd set is committed by the link and nothing is revealed.

vectors.name: swatch-selective
vectors.why: A loomseal-chain-v1 claim commits three redactable fields as an _sd set and discloses two; each disclosure hashes to a committed digest and the withheld field stays sealed.

vectors.name: swatch-wrong-profile
vectors.why: Selective disclosure on switchtender-audit-v1 is refused, because that profile's fixed-field link does not commit the _sd set.

vectors.name: switchtender-audit
vectors.why: The shipped SwitchTender profile recomputes every link.

vectors.name: switchtender-audit-anchored-proof
vectors.why: An rfc3161 anchor carrying a real timestamp token verifies offline against the link it attests to, with no network and no trust in the producer.

vectors.name: switchtender-audit-bound-install
vectors.why: A switchtender-audit-v1 entry that carries install_id folds it into its link and binds the entry to the producer, which an entry omitting it does not.

vectors.name: switchtender-audit-json-escapes
vectors.why: A recorded path carrying &, <, > and U+2028 verifies, because the profile serializes with RFC 8785 rather than an encoder that escapes those characters for HTML.

vectors.name: switchtender-audit-nanosecond-at
vectors.why: A claim time carrying sub-microsecond digits verifies, because the profile hashes the stored time bytes rather than parsing and re-serializing them.

vectors.name: switchtender-foreign-install
vectors.why: A bound switchtender-audit-v1 entry whose folded install_id is not the producer's is refused, which is what stops a published receipt from being lifted into another install's bundle.

vectors.name: switchtender-install-legacy-from-another-key
vectors.why: A switchtender-audit-v1 install id in the legacy form minted from another key is refused for the same reason.

vectors.name: switchtender-install-legacy-from-producer-key
vectors.why: A switchtender-audit-v1 install id in the legacy form, the producer key's first six bytes, verifies unpinned.

vectors.name: switchtender-install-minted-from-another-key
vectors.why: A switchtender-audit-v1 install id minted from another key is refused: it is a key rotation or another install's history re-signed, and only the relying party can accept a rotation, by pinning the key and naming the install.

vectors.name: switchtender-install-minted-from-producer-key
vectors.why: A switchtender-audit-v1 install id minted from the producer's own key verifies unpinned.

vectors.name: switchtender-outcome-exact
vectors.why: An outcome committed under the exact form reproduces its entry's digest from the bytes carried, and the spec beside it hashes to the spec digest the outcome names.

vectors.name: switchtender-outcome-exact-altered
vectors.why: A receipt whose exact-form outcome was changed and re-signed fails, because the bytes carried no longer reproduce the digest the entry committed and the link fixed.

vectors.name: switchtender-outcome-legacy
vectors.why: An outcome committed under an older form, over the producer's own redaction of the record, verifies as carried and unchecked, never as verified, and the spec beside it has nothing verified to be held against.

vectors.name: switchtender-outcome-spec-altered
vectors.why: A receipt with no decision whose disclosed spec was changed and re-signed fails, because the spec no longer hashes to the spec digest the verified outcome names.

vectors.name: switchtender-params-disagrees
vectors.why: A switchtender-audit-v1 chain.params.install_id that is not the producer's is refused: the param is informational and the per-claim install_id is what binds.

vectors.name: switchtender-params-only
vectors.why: A switchtender-audit-v1 chain that stamps chain.params.install_id without folding it into its links verifies as pre-binding: the param is not part of this profile's link, so a producer adopting per-entry binding keeps every receipt it already published.

vectors.name: switchtender-record-correction
vectors.why: A correction appended to a decision's reason reproduces its own entry's content digest, and its text opens the commitment bound to the correction's id.

vectors.name: switchtender-record-correction-altered
vectors.why: A receipt whose disclosed correction text was changed and re-signed fails, because the text no longer opens the commitment the correction body carries.

vectors.name: switchtender-record-decision-altered
vectors.why: A receipt whose disclosed decision body was changed and re-signed fails, because the body no longer reproduces the content digest its entry committed and the link fixed.

vectors.name: switchtender-record-names-chain-v1
vectors.why: The same names on a claim that is no record, under a profile whose link commits the whole claim, are committed members like any other and verify.

vectors.name: switchtender-record-names-off-record
vectors.why: Record member names on a claim whose committed method and path make it no record are ordinary members, whatever they hold: a bundle that used them as plain fields before records existed verifies as it always did, with each reported unchecked.

vectors.name: switchtender-record-reason
vectors.why: A decision body that reproduces its entry's keyed content digest, a reason that opens the commitment the body carries, and a spec that hashes to the digest the decision committed all verify.

vectors.name: switchtender-record-reason-altered
vectors.why: A receipt whose disclosed reason was changed and re-signed by the producer keeps its signature and every link, and still fails, because the text no longer opens the commitment the decision body carries.

vectors.name: switchtender-record-reason-redacted
vectors.why: A reason removed by a privacy redaction is reported by its category and verifies: its text and random value are gone, its commitment stays, and it cannot be opened by design.

vectors.name: switchtender-record-reason-uncommitted
vectors.why: A reason disclosed beside a decision body that commits none fails: it is text the chain never fixed, and a reader must not be shown it as part of the record.

vectors.name: switchtender-record-reason-withheld
vectors.why: A decision body that commits a reason the receipt does not disclose verifies, with the reason reported as committed and not disclosed.

vectors.name: switchtender-record-spec-altered
vectors.why: A receipt whose disclosed spec was changed and re-signed fails, because it no longer hashes to the spec digest the verified decision committed.

vectors.name: switchtender-record-unkeyed
vectors.why: A decision recorded before nonces carries the unkeyed content digest and an empty nonce, and its body verifies against the SHA-256 of its canonical bytes, reported as legacy, since nothing before it in the bundle is keyed.

vectors.name: switchtender-record-unkeyed-after-keyed
vectors.why: A decision under the unkeyed content digest after an entry under the keyed form fails: the producer was keying its digests by then, so the entry is not one from before nonces, and an unkeyed digest lets anyone holding the bundle confirm a guess of the body.

vectors.why: Claim 0's args, altered and re-signed by the producer, verifies with the member reported unchecked, as schema/claim-members.json declares.

vectors.name: tamper-loomseal-agentrun-1-args-case

vectors.name: tampered-payload
vectors.why: A byte changed after signing fails the producer signature.

vectors.name: unknown-chain-profile
vectors.why: A chain profile this verifier does not implement is refused as unsupported, a fail-closed verdict distinct from verification failure, so a legitimate newer bundle never reads as forged.

vectors.name: unknown-claim-member
vectors.why: A claim member the schema does not define fails at parse, before the signature is examined.

vectors.name: unknown-claim-type
vectors.why: A claim type outside the registry verifies and is noted, never failed.

vectors.name: unknown-envelope-member
vectors.why: A bundle member the schema does not define fails at parse. Strict rejection of the unknown is the design: nothing unspecified rides inside an accepted bundle.

vectors.name: valid-surrogate-pair
vectors.why: An astral character encodes as a surrogate pair and verifies.

vectors.name: window-open-no-prev
vectors.why: A linear window opening at seq 5 with an empty prev is refused: a slice of a longer chain must link to the entry before it, or it is claiming to be unrooted at an arbitrary point.

vectors.name: windowed-head
vectors.why: A head beyond the claims is a window; its link is unverified and it is not anchored.

vectors.name: wrong-version
vectors.why: A loomseal version this verifier does not implement is refused as unsupported without judging the signature. Fail closed, but never worded as a verification failure.
